title: Secret lookup
description: The outside part's request to the credential proxy: resolve one declared secret by name, at call time, for one transaction and one outside operation (REQ-MDL-6, REQ-MDL-17, ADR-0004). The proxy resolves only a secret that operation declares, so while serving one operation the outside part can't resolve a secret only another uses (REQ-MDL-3). Only the outside part can make it; nothing the sandboxed part sends or declares names a secret. It names no provider: the proxy answers only for the calling process's own provider, known from the process and never from the request, so a module can't ask for another provider's secrets (DEC-9, REQ-MDL-9). The provider's statement-signing key is not a declared secret and is not resolved with this shape: it is declared as the outside part's statement_key, and the outside part resolves it by the deployment's name when it signs a result. That lookup has no wire shape here; the credential proxy's side is F-014's. The module never holds the key (DEC-4, T-003-01).

transaction.description: The transaction the secret is used for, so each use is attributable to one (REQ-MDL-6).

operation.description: The declared outside operation the secret is used for. A secret that operation doesn't declare is refused (undeclared_secret), even if another operation declares it.
